item.title: Across The Block
item.description: This week, auctions across the country saw success in a variety of collecting categories. Art highlights ranged from an abstract painting that generated $20,740 at Nadeau’s to an original comic art painting by Frank Frazetta that brought more than $3 million at Heritage. item.title: Funerary Stele Marks Top Price At Sworders
item.description: ESSEX, UK — Leading Sworders Fine Art Auctioneers’ February 24 auction featuring the collection of veteran antiques dealer Peter Petrou was a Greek marble funerary stele from the Hellenistic period, Second-First Century BCE, that attained $33,000, including the buyer’s premium. item.title: Ancient Art Takes Center Stage At Everything But The House
item.description: CINCINNATI — Everything But The House bills itself as the marketplace for the uncommon, and its February 16-22 auction was all that and more. item.title: Estate Finds Earn Big At Burchard
item.description: ST PETERSBURG, FLA. — On February 22, Burchard Galleries conducted its Estate Antiques, Fine Art & Jewelry Auction, which featured 523 lots of museum quality antiques, fine art, sculpture and jewelry from several major estates, including that of Baroness Lizelotte von Schwarzbek of Austria. The post Estate Finds Earn Big At Burchard first appeared on Antiques And The Arts Weekly.

item.title: Coastal Italy Looks Nice To Helmuth Stone Bidders
item.description: SARASOTA, FLA. — In Helmuth Stone’s March 8 auction of fine art and antiques, a painting by Franz Richard Unterberger (Austrian, 1838-1902) beat out the 186 other lots to achieve the sale-high price of $24,570, including buyer’s premium. item.title: Irma Stein Still Life Leads Nadeau’s
